faq_heading: Maple Ridge houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Maple Ridge houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 136 of 544, or 25%. A further 163 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: $1,180,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $999,975 and $1,352,750.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Southwest Maple Ridge, at $1,039,000 across 70 sales at $529 a square foot, median year built 1981. The highest of the 5 lowest was Cottonwood MR at $1,195,000.

faq.q: How fast do Maple Ridge houses sell?
faq.a: 24 days at the median, closing at 97.2% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Maple Ridge, 136 of the 544 houses (25%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $1,180,000, with the middle half between $999,975 and $1,352,750. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 179 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Maple Ridge

In Southwest Maple Ridge the median house sold for $1,039,000 across 70 sales, $39,000 over $1,000,000. Across Maple Ridge the median house took 24 days to sell and closed at 97.2% of the last list price, with 6% of the 544 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
